claims.quote: Univariate analysis showed that the T allele and TT genotype distribution for rs211037 were significantly more frequent in the IS group compared to controls (pallele = 0.01, odds ratio (OR) = 1.673, 95% confidence intervals (CI), 1.119-2.500, pgenotype = 0.03).
the TT genotype for rs211037 was an independent risk factor for IS (p = 0.017, OR = 1.925, 95% CI, 1.122-3.303).
patients with the rs211037 TT genotype were associated with a higher NIHSS score (p = 0.03)
large-artery atherosclerosis (LAA) subtype was predominant in patients with the rs211037 TT genotype (p = 0.042).
